strings.В выписке неправильная характеристика. М: The extract has an incorrect characteristic. I was told every such error is corrected in three days. I brought a corrected plan.
strings.В другом деле регистратор ошибся при наб: In another case, the registrar mistyped a correct document. The technical-error procedure was used there.
strings.В исходной истории неправильную запись в: In the original story, the authority entered the data incorrectly; here the plan itself was wrong. This changes the legal classification and deadline.
strings.В нём была та же неправильная характерис: It contained the same incorrect characteristic that appeared in the extract.
strings.Вид ошибки определяется происхождением,: The error type depends on its origin, not on what the wrong number looks like.
strings.Все участники и документы дела вымышлены: All participants and documents are fictional. An error in the original technical plan has been established and was reproduced exactly in the EGRN. The complete proper correction documents have already been accepted. The correction neither terminates, creates nor transfers a registered right and does not affect third-party interests; there are no special exceptions. You prepare materials and proposed actions, not replace the authorised official's decision. Calculate the register-error correction period under Part 3 of Article 61, not the reply period for an ordinary letter.
strings.Всякая перестановка цифр в ЕГРН является: Every digit transposition in the EGRN is a technical error by the authority.
strings.Вы устанавливаете обстоятельства, находи: Establish the circumstances, find the grounds and prepare proposed actions within your role. The game does not carry out real dispatches, calls, inspections, debits or register changes.
strings.Выясните, к какому объекту, документу и: Establish which property, document and event the question concerns.
strings.Государственный регистратор, а не специа: The state registrar, not the reception-window specialist.
strings.Достаточно желания заявителя; исходный п: The applicant's wish is sufficient; the original plan need not be examined.
strings.Если ошибка уже была в исходном плане, е: If the error was already in the original plan, swapped digits alone do not make it a registrar's typo.
strings.Есть спор о праве или возражения третьих: Is there a dispute over rights or an objection from third parties?
strings.Закрыть дело: любое подтверждение исправ: Close the case: any correction confirmation is enough.
strings.Зафиксировать получение всех необходимых: Record receipt of all required documents and the absence of obstacles.
strings.Изменены существенные обстоятельства, ма: Material circumstances, evidence, legal application and the follow-up episode have changed. Changing dates or names alone does not create a new variant.
strings.Исправление технической описки без прове: Correct a technical typo without checking the source document.
strings.Какой вывод обосновывается совокупностью: Which conclusion is supported by the materials taken together?
strings.Какой идентификатор плана относится к пр: Which plan identifier relates to the accepted case?
strings.Когда получен комплект для исправления?: When were the correction documents received?
strings.Контрольное действие соответствует новым: The follow-up action matches the new circumstances.
strings.Крайний день исправления реестровой ошиб: Last day for correcting a register error
strings.Надлежащий исправленный план и подтвержд: The proper corrected plan and supporting documents arrived on {{received}}. All necessary information is present; registered rights and the lawful interests of third parties do not change.
strings.Найдите норму: Техническая и реестровая: Find the rule: technical and register errors have different grounds. Identify the legal act and article, then select the applicable provision.
strings.Найдите указанную норму во внешнем источ: Find the stated rule in an external source. Compare it with the materials without treating a legal source as proof of a fictional event.
strings.Направить соседу для окончательного реше: Send it to the neighbour for a final decision.
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
strings.Не подтверждается в описанных обстоятель: Not supported in the circumstances described.
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
strings.Обычная переписка по 59-ФЗ вместо принят: Ordinary correspondence under No. 59-FZ instead of the accepted correction procedure.
strings.Ограничения для спорного исправления в у: The conditions do not contain restrictions applicable to a disputed correction.
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило в орган {: Sent on {{sent}}, received by the authority on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The dates when legal acts were adopted do not change with the case year.
strings.Ошибка пришла из исходного плана · матер: The error came from the original plan · materials and legal basis
The error was in the original document.
strings.Первый фрагмент — материал вымышленного: The first excerpt is material from a fictional case, not a real organisation’s publication. The second is the author’s concise summary of the legal provision.
strings.Передать подготовленные материалы регист: Forward the prepared materials to the registrar through the special procedure.
strings.Перезапустить срок от более поздней внут: Restart the deadline from the later internal registration.

strings.Подготовить комплект государственному ре: Prepare the document set for the state registrar of rights.
strings.Подготовлены обоснованные действия по ус: Reasoned actions have been prepared for the established circumstances. Implementation is checked in the next episode.
strings.Подтверждена реестровая ошибка исходного: A register error originating in the original plan is confirmed, not a technical typo by the registrar.

A register error originating in the original plan is confirmed, not a technical typo by the registrar. In the original story, the authority entered the data incorrectly; here the plan itself was wrong. This changes the legal classification and deadline.
strings.Подтверждение одного факта не заменяет р: Confirming one fact does not replace examining the other conditions of the case.
strings.Полный надлежащий комплект получен в ука: The complete proper document set was received on the stated date. A general appeal does not replace the special procedure; the conditions in Part 4 are absent.

The complete proper document set was received on the stated date. A general appeal does not replace the special procedure; the conditions in Part 4 are absent. This exercise counts from the day after the event, moves a non-working final day forward, and uses the federal five-day working week.
strings.Получение полного комплекта и регистраци: Receipt of the complete documents and registration are different events.
strings.Попросить заявителя считать оба плана од: Ask the applicant to treat both plans as one document.
strings.Поручить инженеру напрямую изменить запи: Instruct the engineer to change the EGRN entry directly.
strings.Применять три рабочих дня ко всем неправ: Apply three working days to every incorrect number.
strings.Пришло подтверждение исправления по план: Confirmation arrived of a correction under plan TP-42, but the accepted case concerns TP-41.
strings.Приёмная подтвердила получение полного к: Reception confirmed receipt of the complete documents on {{received}}; internal registration took place on {{registered}}.
strings.Проверить решение и соответствие исправл: Check the decision and whether the correction matches the accepted documents.
strings.Проверьте, какое именно обстоятельство и: Check exactly which circumstance changed and what the new document confirms.
strings.Проверяется результат именно по принятом: The result is checked against the specific accepted document set.
strings.Прочитайте, срок какого действия требует: Read which action's deadline is requested. Do not replace the special period with the general thirty days.
strings.Различайте федеральный закон, Закон РФ и: Distinguish a federal law, a Law of the Russian Federation, and the relevant part of a code. A rule's date is not the event date.
strings.Различать техническую и реестровую ошибк: Distinguish technical errors from register errors by their origin; apply the conditions in Part 3.
The player's role is limited to preparation.
strings.Самостоятельно изменить запись в реестре: Change the register entry independently without a registrar's decision.
strings.Сообщить заявителю предмет процедуры без: Tell the applicant the subject of the procedure without promising to edit the entry independently.
strings.Сопоставить исходный план, запись и испр: Compare the original plan, entry and corrected document set.
strings.Сопоставьте материалы, затем выберите вы: Compare the materials, then choose a conclusion and a sufficient set of supporting grounds.
